<function name="SetColor4Part" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets the color of an entity without usage of a <page>Global.Color</page> object.

<internal>Used internally to implement <page>Entity:SetColor</page>.</internal>
</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="r" type="number"></arg>
		<arg name="g" type="number"></arg>
		<arg name="b" type="number"></arg>
		<arg name="a" type="number"></arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Sets the color of the first player to black</description>
	<code>
Entity(1):SetColor4Part(0, 0, 0, 0)
	</code>
</example>
